comment: Source read at commit 95496e8, HEAD of the maker's repository; its plugin.json is byte-for-byte the installed 2.1.0 manifest. The bit test is a hysteresis pair written out by hand rather than a SchmittTrigger, with the same 1.0f and 0.5f thresholds. The output voltage is literally the eight-bit pattern as a number, so it runs from 0V to 255V; no family is given because it is a coded word rather than a signal of any of the four kinds. The panel prints the inputs 1 to 8, which are indices 0 to 7.
